$comment: Private-target inventory for scripts/agnostic-check (issue #274, AGENTS rule 9). This file is DATA, not prose: the gate refuses a reference to any name/repo/path declared here. `privateRepos` covers the #273 clause — a public surface that links a repo declared `private` fails the gate. Visibility is verified OUT OF BAND (release / pre-merge, where the network is acceptable) and recorded here; the gate never probes, because a required check must not depend on a third party's uptime or rate limits (#132). `operatorPaths` are absolute local paths no reader can open; the generic documentation placeholder `/Users/…` (ellipsis) is NOT a match by construction. Add a target with its reason; remove one when the repo becomes public or the name stops being private. Removing a `privateNames` target has a required second step: remove it from any `allowlist.json` entry's `names` too — the gate refuses a stale name (`E-ALLOWLIST-INVALID`) instead of accepting an exemption that can no longer fire.

It is a SEPARATE entry, not a substring of the one above: the whole-token matcher excludes a trailing `-`, so it never fires inside the hyphenated form and neither entry subsumes the other — removing one leaves the other form unguarded
